name: Macro Shelf
summary: Keeps a spare copy of your macros and moves them between characters as plain text you can copy and paste.
logoPrompt: A small wooden wall shelf holding a neat row of glowing square spell scrolls tied with ribbons

cover.tagline: Your macros, backed up and easy to move.

description: **Macro Shelf saves your macros in a backup and turns them into text you can copy to another character or paste back in.**
- Backs up your account macros and the macros of each character.
- Restores the macros that went missing from that backup.
- Exports all macros as text, already selected for copying.
- Imports such a text from a paste box.
- Never changes or deletes a macro you already have.

Type `/macroshelf` (or `/mshelf`) to open the window. Back up saves your macros, Restore brings back the missing ones. Export shows the text to copy, Import takes a pasted text and creates the macros.
- Creating macros is refused in combat.
- A macro with a name you already use is skipped and named in chat.
- Text with a mistake creates nothing and shows the line to fix.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
